# API reference

This reference is generated from the built TypeScript declarations and covers 301 names across the three supported public entry points. Run `npm run build && npm run docs:api` to refresh it; `npm run check:api` rejects stale output.

## `@dvmkit/sdk/testing`

Deterministic in-memory contexts and stores for testing handlers without a live server or payment rail. Generated from `./dist/testing/index.d.ts`.
